all_required_checks.known_f1_nonregression: absolute GradNorm minus Energy Known F1 <= 1e-12
all_required_checks.metric_breadth: positive mean gain over Energy on at least 2 of 4 metrics
all_required_checks.overall_gain: four-metric mean gain over Energy is positive
all_required_checks.split_integrity: GradNorm, source MLP and OpenDetect splits identical
all_required_checks.suite_robustness: at least 4/7 suites nonnegative and worst >= -0.05
all_required_checks.top_two_rank: GradNorm mean rank among three methods <= 2.0

failure_action: retain the negative pilot and stop expansion
full_matrix_action: run all 102 seed7 scenarios only if every check passes
